evidence.detail: Date cell is {{display_date}} — no title attribute with exact date
Same pattern: {{display_date}} rendered without a title attribute
display_date() returns only relative text ('3 days ago', 'Jan 3rd') with no exact ISO date; no companion exact-date function exists
prepare_decks sets d.display_date and d.date_sort but no d.display_date_title
prepare_matches sets m.display_date and m.date_sort but no m.display_date_title

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Add exact_date(dt) to shared/dtutil.py returning e.g. dt.astimezone(WOTC_TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'). 2) In decksite/prepare.py, set d.display_date_title = dtutil.exact_date(d.active_date) for decks and m.display_date_title = dtutil.exact_date(m.date) for matches. 3) Wrap {{display_date}} in a <span title="{{display_date_title}}"> in the affected templates: deckmatches.mustache, personmatches.mustache, deckrow.mustache, competitions.mustache, news.mustache, playernotes.mustache, subtitle.mustache.
triage.notes: The pattern of using title attributes is already established in prepare.py for top8_safe and stars_safe; this follows the same convention. No schema changes, no data-retention implications.
